scope: Independent new passive release assessment of exact frozen Oct16 candidate; no retuning or model promotion
caveats: Operator hand restraint remains an assumption; counted position or pixel stability cannot certify metric stationarity.
Fitted Oct16 local gravity phase is reused unchanged, not an independent global encoder calibration.
Half-second forecasts reinitialize from past raw angles; continuous rollouts initialize only once after~0.1s.
Nominal episode angle labels are operator instructions, not calibrated measured amplitudes.
Plots choose an integer 2pi raw-angle display branch only; no fitted zero or phase is removed from recorded measurements.

continuous_rollouts.scope: One initial condition, past11 angles over40ms at250Hz; continuous diagnostic after~0.1s prefix. Fixed cart and local phase assumed, no acceptance gate.
